title: Relief and Carrying Rates on the Standing Charge of a Closed Micro Market
content:
How regularly a client of the Unattended Micro Market Program has settled over the trailing year, together with the balance standing unsettled on the agreement, can move the standing charge taken for each month of a closure away from the standby charge printed against the market format.

## Conditions

**The prompt relief share of 94 per cent of the standby charge printed against the market format** is taken where the client settled at or above 3 market settlement invoices over the twelve months to the day the settlement is raised, and the balance standing unsettled on the agreement is below the minimum funding lot printed against the market format. Both limbs must hold.

**The carrying share of 106 per cent of the standby charge printed against the market format** is taken where the client settled at or below 1 market settlement invoice over those twelve months, or the balance standing unsettled on the agreement is at or above the minimum funding lot printed against the market format. Either limb on its own is enough.

**Where neither condition holds**, no such relief or uplift is taken.

## The boundaries

The prompt settlement count is 3 settlement payments over the trailing twelve months, a year carrying exactly 3 meeting it and a year carrying 2 not. The slow settlement count is 1, a year carrying 1 payment or none meeting it and a year carrying 2 not. The balance standing unsettled is compared with the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, a balance standing exactly at that figure counting as at or above it.

*Hypothetical.* A client settling 6 invoices over the trailing year with 500.00 USD unsettled, against a printed minimum funding lot of 6500.00 USD and a printed standby charge of 940.00 USD, takes a standing charge of 883.60 USD for each month of the closure. Had 7000.00 USD been standing unsettled, the standing charge would be 996.40 USD for each month.
